title: Spikers' Turf: Player of the Week Mendoza shines as FEU reaches semis
summary: Lirick Mendoza stepped up to lead Far Eastern University to a place in the semifinals of the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference, in the process earning Player of the Week honors.
